summary: Add one repository-root build.sh launcher, update source-start documentation, and verify through shell syntax, no-browser smoke startup, backend tests, frontend typecheck/build, and AppForge gates.
goal: Make the existing AppForge-LLM v4 browser pipeline the easiest source checkout path by letting users run ./build.sh to prepare and open the local web UI.

changes.change: Add executable bash launcher with argument parsing, safe defaults, Python setup via uv or venv/pip fallback, frontend install/build, optional bridge startup, foreground appforge web mode, --no-open, --check, --smoke, bounded HTTP probes, and cleanup traps for launcher-owned processes.
changes.reason: This directly satisfies the requested one-command web UI pipeline while delegating server behavior to the existing appforge web entry point.

changes.change: Document ./build.sh as the fastest source-start path, list useful launcher environment variables/options, and keep manual appforge web/frontend development commands.
changes.reason: Source users should discover the new web-first UX before the longer manual CLI setup.
changes.verification: Manual doc review and grep for ./build.sh/--smoke in README.md.

changes.change: Update start instructions with ./build.sh, --smoke, --no-open/APPFORGE_NO_OPEN, and optional llm_bridge startup behavior.
changes.reason: The web app guide is the operational reference for starting and verifying the local UI.
changes.verification: Manual doc review and grep for ./build.sh/APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE in docs/WEB_APP.md.

changes.change: Record the launcher and smoke verification behavior.
changes.reason: The startup UX change is user-facing and should be visible in release notes.
changes.verification: Manual doc review and grep for build.sh in CHANGELOG.md.

changes.change: Update feature-pipeline artifacts and checkpoints for this launcher request through appforge complete.
changes.reason: The repository tracks AppForge control-plane artifacts, and this request must have its own artifact/checkpoint loop.
changes.verification: .venv/bin/python -m appforge status . reports all stages complete after handoff.

migration_or_compatibility: Existing appforge web, appforge-web, appforge forge/run/status/prompt/complete, frontend dev, and llm_bridge commands remain available.
Default web binding remains 127.0.0.1:8787 unless overridden by APPFORGE_WEB_HOST/APPFORGE_WEB_PORT.
No existing provider secrets or driver configuration are changed.
build.sh is additive and can be ignored by users who prefer manual CLI startup.
risks: First-run dependency installation can fail in restricted network environments; skip flags and existing prepared workspace verification mitigate this.
Smoke tests can collide with an occupied port; APPFORGE_WEB_PORT allows selecting another loopback port.
Bridge startup could complicate non-bridge usage; the launcher starts bridge only for llm-bridge driver or explicit APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE=1.
Shell cleanup must avoid killing unrelated processes; cleanup stores and kills only launcher-owned PIDs.
rollback: Remove build.sh and revert README.md/docs/WEB_APP.md/CHANGELOG.md documentation edits.
Rerun appforge web manually using existing documented commands.
If packaged web assets are refreshed by npm build, rebuild from the previous source or restore the prior asset files from Git.
No database or runtime migration rollback is needed.
definition_of_done: build.sh exists at repository root and is executable.
APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --smoke passes and cleans up.
README.md, docs/WEB_APP.md, and CHANGELOG.md document the launcher.
AppForge verification, security, release, and handoff stages pass and produce a source archive.
